subject: general
question: What advanced technology is being tested in ISRO's new "Next Generation Launch Vehicle" (NGLV) project to replace PSLV and GSLV?

options.text: Reusable booster stage with semi-cryogenic engine

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Reusable booster stage with semi-cryogenic engine**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Next Generation Launch Vehicle (NGLV)** project by ISRO is aimed at replacing the **Polar Satellite Launch Vehicle (PSLV)** and **Geosynchronous Satellite Launch Vehicle (GSLV)**.
 
• A key feature of the NGLV is its **reusable booster stage**, which is equipped with a **semi-cryogenic engine**.
